details.usageInstructions:
Remove the plastic cover and unfold the bag, Place bag Instruction SIDE UP in centre of Oven, Microwave on High (full power) for 2 to 3 minutes,
Listen carefully stop microwave when popping slows to 1 to 2 seconds between pops, Be careful not to overcook as popcorn will scorch,
Handle hot bag carefully, For optimum flavour, Shake bag before opening, Open by tugging to diagonal corners.
